title: Platform detection
description: Auto-detect the target platform (web-electron-ts vs other) from project files, scaffold-design.md, or human input before any UI design steps run.

title: Layout capture via Figma reference
description: Read a Figma file or node via get_metadata and get_screenshot to capture structural layout and visual reference for component mapping.

title: ReUI component mapping
description: Map each layout section to a free-tier ReUI component via the ReUI MCP search tool; flag unmatched sections as gaps without silent substitution.

title: Design doc and roadmap output
description: Write design.md, design.html companion, roadmap.json entries, and ROADMAP.html after approval; hand off to writing-plans as the terminal state.

title: Brainstorming injection point
description: Detect a user-facing surface after Architecture approval in brainstorming and invoke designing-ui as a sub-flow; brainstorming then calls writing-plans once with both spec paths.

title: Project-kickoff injection point
description: Detect a FrontEnd stack from Phase 2 Stack answer in project-kickoff and invoke designing-ui as a sub-flow for the initial UI shell; project-kickoff then calls writing-plans once with both spec paths.

title: Branch/worktree created at brainstorming start
description: Create an isolated feature branch and worktree after context exploration and the scope check so the spec, plan, and implementation land on one branch.

title: Resume an in-progress feature branch in a fresh session
description: Reuse an existing unmerged feature branch and worktree that matches the slug instead of creating a duplicate in a fresh session.

title: Pattern doc with normative fenced block table and exclusion fences
description: Single normative file defining every required block by ID, validator marker, tier, and omit-when condition — block table fenced for machine parsing, exclusion list fenced for visibility.

title: Structural validator script that parses the doc and checks all in-scope skills
description: Bash script that reads the block table from the pattern doc, applies all six rules to every in-scope skills/*/SKILL.md, and exits non-zero with one line per violation.

title: README Pattern Omissions section format specified and enforced by rules 2–4
description: Documented and machine-enforced format for recording why a conditional block is absent; rules 2–4 keep omission records honest as skills evolve.

title: writing-skills/SKILL.md generic structure section replaced by a pointer
description: The generic '## SKILL.md Structure' section body in writing-skills/SKILL.md is replaced with a short pointer to workflow-skill-pattern.md, eliminating the competing template.

title: Validator self-check fixture proving rule 6 fails loudly
description: Fixture that strips the block table from the pattern doc and asserts the validator exits non-zero, preventing a doc edit from silently making the validator a no-op.

title: tests/skills/run-all.sh wired in tests/split/run-all.sh style
description: Runner that discovers and executes all test-*.sh files in tests/skills/, accumulates failures, and prints ALL SKILL TESTS PASS on success — matching the existing split test runner idiom.

title: Eval harness foundation verified and gating
description: Confirm the eval harness runs in this environment (bun install, quorum check, one throwaway run) before any skill migration begins; sub-project B stops if the harness cannot run.

title: Per-skill migration work unit executes end to end for one skill
description: Repeatable 7-step work unit (scenario check, baseline run, migrate, after run, gate, validator, commit) applied to each of 18 in-scope skills in SDLC.md order.

title: README Pattern Migration Notes with NEW review marker
description: Each migrated skill's README carries a Pattern Migration Notes section distinguishing DERIVED blocks (no behavior change) from **NEW** blocks (authored gap-fill, with inline eval evidence).

title: Derived-block migration passes the no-regression A/B gate
description: Derived blocks (existing content restructured) are gated by after >= baseline rather than a classical RED-GREEN cycle; the distinction is named plainly to avoid overclaiming.

title: Gap-fill content passes true RED-GREEN with a failing baseline
description: Authored gap-fill blocks must show a failing baseline before the content is added and a passing after-run; a NEW block whose baseline did not fail must be revised or reclassified.

title: Eval scenarios authored for the 9 uncovered skills
description: Each of the 9 skills with zero eval coverage (project-kickoff, designing-ui, requesting-plan-refine, receiving-plan-refine, sprint-retrospective, writing-skills, backlog-refinement, dispatch-agent, worker-healing) gains a scenario as part of its migration commit.

title: All 18 skills migrated; validator reports zero violations repo-wide
description: After the final migration commit, bash tests/skills/run-all.sh exits zero and tests/split/run-all.sh shows exactly 17 pre-existing failures — no new failures introduced.
